Implemented the SQLite-backed job tracker across [src/db.ts](/opt/harness/work/.runs/campaign/cohort-03/block-02/slot-07-pi.AF-CC.on/attempt-1/workspace/src/db.ts), [src/server.ts](/opt/harness/work/.runs/campaign/cohort-03/block-02/slot-07-pi.AF-CC.on/attempt-1/workspace/src/server.ts), [src/worker.ts](/opt/harness/work/.runs/campaign/cohort-03/block-02/slot-07-pi.AF-CC.on/attempt-1/workspace/src/worker.ts), and [ui/index.html](/opt/harness/work/.runs/campaign/cohort-03/block-02/slot-07-pi.AF-CC.on/attempt-1/workspace/ui/index.html). It includes API validation and idempotency, durable job state, worker retries and progress, heartbeat health reporting, and a polling browser UI.

`npm run build` passes. The worker completed a seeded retry job successfully. HTTP smoke and contract checks could not run because the sandbox rejected server binding with `listen EPERM`.
